title: Modelling cited in support of the scheme found that additional Queensland supply would lower wholesale prices in New South Wales and Victoria
oneLiner: The government's 'modest oversupply' claim rests on this kind of result.
body: An Energy Edge study cited by The Conversation found that extra gas from Queensland flowing south would reduce prices in the southern states, where the Bass Strait decline is sharpest. The government expects the reservation to create a modest domestic oversupply with the same effect.
contextBackground: This is the factual plank under the government's price claim. It is modelling of supply effects, not of the scheme as finally designed.
contextDisagreement: Critics accept the direction and dispute the magnitude once exemptions and the demand peg are applied.

evidenceItems.citation: The Conversation, Kevin Morrison, 7 May 2026 — Energy Edge study on southern prices

otherClaim.title: Because export contracts signed before 22 December 2025 are exempt, the scheme reaches too little gas to move prices for years

claimItself.title: Because export contracts signed before 22 December 2025 are exempt, the scheme reaches too little gas to move prices for years
claimItself.oneLiner: Most current east-coast production is already contracted; the reserve bites only on new supply.
claimItself.body: The announced scheme preserves foundation contracts and any signed before the December 2025 cut-off. Since the three Queensland ventures sold most of their output under long-term contracts years ago, the gas actually subject to reservation is a thin slice of new and uncontracted supply, which critics say is too small to shift the domestic price before the 2030s.

ownArguments.label: FOR
ownArguments.text: In September 2026 the reservation was recast to about 110 per cent of forecast domestic demand, and Santos is the only major east-coast producer not already supplying the domestic market

ownArguments.label: AGAINST
ownArguments.text: Modelling cited in support of the scheme found that additional Queensland supply would lower wholesale prices in New South Wales and Victoria

usedIn.relationSentence: This claim contradicts “Because export contracts signed before 22 December 2025 are exempt, the scheme reaches too little gas to move prices for years”

strengthDefinitions.decisive: It defeats the parent claim if accepted.
strengthDefinitions.relevant: It counts against the parent claim without settling it.
strengthDefinitions.tangential: True perhaps, but it does not land against this claim.
